title: Error-budget fabric and initiative handshake protocol
creator: Nikhil Rao
description: Design and implement a lightweight 'error-budget fabric' and handshake protocol for initiatives that need to consume or contribute to shared error budget pools. This ticket covers the PM scope: define the API surface, ownership signals, telemetry mapping to SLI buckets, rollout gating defaults, and a minimal console UX to visualize fabric allocations across teams. The aim is to reduce ambiguity when one team's remediation impacts another's error budget by providing a standardized request/claim/release flow and visibility hooks for runbooks, canaries, and autoscale throttles.
acceptance_criteria: Fabric API spec published in Confluence and reviewed by Eng/Design/SEC
Console widget shows per-initiative allocated budget and live burn rate; drilldown to contributing routes
Automated handshake flows for borrow/return with TTL implemented in orchestration layer
Alerting rules and rollback policy wired to initiative claims; links to runbooks in alerts
Documentation and migration guide for teams to opt into fabric w/ examples
